import re
SECTION = re.compile(r"^== (?P<title>.*?) ==\s*$")
GROUP = re.compile(r"^-- (?P<title>.*?) --\s*$")
UDID = r"[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}"
DTYPE = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>\S.*?) \((?P<identifier>com\.apple\.CoreSimulator\.SimDeviceType\.\S+)\)\s*$")
RUNTIME = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>\S.*?) \((?P<version>\S+) - (?P<build>\S+)\) - "
                     r"(?P<identifier>com\.apple\.CoreSimulator\.SimRuntime\.\S+)"
                     r"(?: \((?P<availability>.*)\))?\s*$")
DEVICE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<name>\S.*?) \((?P<udid>" + UDID + r")\) \((?P<state>[^)]*)\)"
                    r"(?: \((?P<availability>.*)\))?\s*$")
PAIR = re.compile(r"^(?P<udid>" + UDID + r") \((?P<state>[^)]*)\)\s*$")
MEMBER = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<role>\w+): (?P<name>\S.*?) \((?P<udid>" + UDID + r")\) \((?P<state>[^)]*)\)"
                    r"(?: \((?P<availability>.*)\))?\s*$")

def parse(lines):
    blocks = {}
    def add(name, j, rec):
        b = blocks.setdefault(name, {"name": name, "kind": "table", "lines": [], "records": []})
        b["lines"].append(j)
        if rec is not None:
            b["records"].append(rec)
    skip = []
    section, group, pair = "", "", ""
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = SECTION.match(ln)
        if m:
            section = m.group("title").lower()
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = GROUP.match(ln)
        if m:
            group = m.group("title")
            add(section, j, None)
            continue
        if section == "device types":
            m = DTYPE.match(ln)
            if m:
                add(section, j, {"name": m.group("name"), "identifier": m.group("identifier")})
        elif section == "runtimes":
            m = RUNTIME.match(ln)
            if m:
                g = m.groupdict()
                add(section, j, {k: g[k] or "" for k in ("name", "version", "build", "identifier", "availability")})
        elif section == "devices":
            m = DEVICE.match(ln)
            if m:
                g = m.groupdict()
                add(section, j, {"runtime": group, "name": g["name"], "udid": g["udid"],
                                 "state": g["state"], "availability": g["availability"] or ""})
        elif section == "device pairs":
            m = PAIR.match(ln)
            if m:
                pair = m.group("udid")
                add(section, j, {"udid": pair, "state": m.group("state")})
                continue
            m = MEMBER.match(ln)
            if m:
                g = m.groupdict()
                add("device pair members", j, {"pair": pair, "role": g["role"], "name": g["name"],
                                               "udid": g["udid"], "state": g["state"],
                                               "availability": g["availability"] or ""})
    return {"blocks": list(blocks.values()), "skip": skip}
